description.value: Social Crust Cafe & Catering is a social enterprise cafe in downtown Vancouver operated by Coast Mental Health, channeling revenue toward mental health programs and services. The cafe offers food and catering in the heart of the city's business district on West Pender Street. As of spring 2026 it expanded to seven-day-a-week service, making it more accessible to weekend riders passing through.
